content.comment_body: I'm experiencing issues with the network analog input. After configuring the TCP/IP server and entering the addresses for the network analog input, I connected it to an analog amplifier, but the Ax value remains at "0" and doesn't change, even when going online. The I/O status indicates that the TCP/IP mapping is successful. I want to use Ax for further calculations, but it's always "0". Could you provide some advice?

You're seeing incorrect values during the online test. The expanded parameter fields beneath analog blocks only update during simulation. When performing an online test, you will only see the initial value of a block. To view the output value, place your cursor on the desired block; a glasses icon will appear below it. Click this icon to open an output field displaying the current starting value.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unclear about real-time network analog input monitoring, noting that the value remains at zero after setup and viewing status online. The underlying issue is the limited feedback available during online monitoring, which causes misunderstanding about where live analog input values are displayed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reliably view live network analog input values during online operation and to utilize these actual values (such as Ax) in subsequent calculations.
